items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: And it was arranged by Artie Matthews. Artie Matthews arranged it. Same guy with the Worry Blues.

ctx.x: So there was a point. I think it's very significant that the year 1912, you had four published blues in four separate cities really, weren't they?

They weren't published, but they were in existence by copyright. By copyright from four different sources. Now Baby Seals Blues was published in that same year, before Handys. But it was a song that put the blues into the song, you see. So it wasn't a 12 bar blues. But you can take the first 12 bars of the verse and stop right there and you've got 12 bar blues. But it goes right on from there, right along into the song, Baby Seals Blues. Well, that was published in Columbia, Missouri, I believe. And it was…

Yeah. But that wasn't really a blues. When was Worry Blues written? It was 14 or 15. Oh, it was, 15. About 15. No, it was. Well, it is a blues. Oh, it's a blues. Is it a blues? I thought it was more of a ragtime.
